name: Ridge Walk
description: A quiet patience game. Seven ridges of cards and a path that climbs and falls one step at a time. Walk the path to clear every ridge.
author: Lullshift

help.summary: Seven ridges of five face-up cards, one path card and a stock. Play the top card of a ridge onto the path when it is exactly one higher or one lower (a King and an Ace count as neighbours).
help.goal: Clear all 35 ridge cards. Deals are quick and random, so some cannot be cleared; Try again and New deal are always there. There is no timer.
howToPlay: Only the top card of each ridge can be played. The cards under it are waiting.
Play a top card if its rank is exactly one above or one below the card on the path. A King connects to an Ace and an Ace to a King, so the ranks go round in a circle.
Stuck? Flip card turns the next stock card onto the path. You may flip whenever you like.
If the stock runs out and nothing fits, the path ends there. Try again replays the same deal, New deal gives a fresh one.
Undo takes back your last play or flip, as many times as you like.

controls.action: Jump to the first or last ridge
Reach Undo, Flip card, Try again and New deal

tips: Ridge cards that fit the path card have a coloured outline.
Before you play, look for a card in the other direction too: a 6 can follow a 5 or go before a 7.
Flipping is free, but each flip changes the path card, so look at the ridges first.
You can stop at any time. Your game is saved and waits for you.
